verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim officially ships Python namespace packages that can be installed via pip and used to compose an app by parts. The docs also mention standalone Python scripting to control robots and environments, plus ROS 2 service and action control. That is a real first-party SDK, but only for one language. missing for 10: evidence of official TypeScript, Go, or C++ SDKs, evidence the SDKs are typed, evidence of coverage of the platform's full surface, independent corroboration.
